label: Biscuit (3D: a corgi pup does zoomies, chases its tail and brings the letter)

preset.title: Biscuit Says Woof
preset.intro: Lay the card flat, point your phone at it, and call Biscuit.
body: A very small dog with very short legs ran all the way round the park to bring you this.
Happy birthday. Every walk is better with you.
preset.from: With love and a wagging tail

groups.title: The board
groups.note: The words on the board that springs up while Biscuit howls. Up to about 40 letters; longer words get smaller.
